product.title: Moab Afternoon Half Day Rafting Trip - Colorado River

description.text: Get a taste of what eastern Utah has to offer and spend your afternoon rafting down the Colorado River in the Moab area on this exciting excursion. Take in the desert landscapes as you navigate rapids and paddle through red rock canyons, Castle Valley, and Fisher Towers. After a few hours on the water, feel rejuvenated and excited to explore the rest of Moab.Learn about the local geology and history All necessary rafting equipment is provided A central meeting point makes for an easy start No prior whitewater rafting experience is required Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
